notes: Kept beside valid/runs/performance-stocktake-report, which is the real run this fixture was standing in for and which settles the shape question outright. What it still covers is the far end of the workflow, which a run stopped at its first gate cannot reach: orchestrator.type spelled explicitly, a terminal task.status completed with every phase in completed_phases, performance_context.phase_summaries.specification populated rather than null, a verification_context that actually verified something (last_status passed, issues_found 0), and an artifacts entry whose html companion is non-null. Synthesized originally from the performance orchestrator's own field set plus the shared verification_context block; the caveat it used to carry - that no real run existed to re-sample from - is discharged and the coverage row no longer reports the debt.
